title: [P2] Script validation `field == null` does not match a field omitted on insert
body:
## Problem
A script validation whose condition checks `record.<field> == null` does **not** fire on `insert` when that optional field is **omitted entirely** from the payload (the key is absent from the validation record context). It works on update and when the field is explicitly `null`.

## Repro
- `todo_task` rule `record.priority == "urgent" && record.due_date == null ...`: creating `{priority:'urgent'}` with no `due_date` key → **passes** (should fail). PATCHing an existing task to urgent+null due → correctly blocked.
- Pre-existing `compliance_assessment.failed_requires_remediation` has the identical gap.
- `expense_line` receipt rule fires on insert only because `receipt_attached` has a `defaultValue` (always present).

## Expected
On insert, normalize the validation record context so omitted optional fields read as `null` (so `field == null` matches).

## Affected
`@objectstack/objectql` (validation context build).


---
_Found while runtime-testing `objectstack-ai/templates` (all 9 templates via `objectstack dev all`) on `@objectstack` 9.5.1. Build + typecheck pass; these only surface at runtime._
